transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support. My name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam. I'm calling from my old mobile because I'm trying to activate the eSIM on my brand new iPhone 15, but whenever I scan the QR code from the confirmation email, it says 'Unable to complete cellular plan change - QR code expired'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you generate a fresh eSIM activation profile, Una. Before we access the mobile provisioning gateway, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 15 Pembroke Crescent, Hove, BN3 5DG. And the security question answer is my first pet's name, Bramble.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Una, that verifies your account file. What is the mobile telephone number associated with this new eSIM order?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone number is 07700 900582. I need this phone working urgently because I am a freelance court interpreter and have a critical multilingual trial hearing starting at two o'clock this afternoon! If the solicitors cannot reach me, I lose the assignment!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the urgency with your court interpretation hearing this afternoon, Una. Having an unactivated SIM when solicitors are trying to reach you is very stressful, so let us get this eSIM profile generated and connected immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Liam, that calms my panic knowing you can sort it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, the original eSIM QR code delivered in your welcome email has expired beyond its forty-eight hour validity window, preventing your new iPhone 15 from downloading the carrier profile, and you need a fresh profile issued right now. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly right. I bought the phone on Friday but only had time to set it up this morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will open our mobile network HLR provisioning database to regenerate your digital SIM profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, standing by with the new iPhone in hand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The mobile provisioning engine has released the locked profile and assigned a new digital EID pairing token.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great! Will you email me a new QR code, or can we enter it manually into the iPhone settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Entering the details manually via the SM-DP+ server address is much faster because it bypasses email spam filters entirely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, let's do manual entry! Where do I go in Settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On your new iPhone, open Settings, tap Mobile Service, then tap Add eSIM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Settings... Mobile Service... Add eSIM. A screen popped up asking to transfer from nearby iPhone or use QR Code.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap Use QR Code, and at the bottom of the camera scanner screen, tap 'Enter Details Manually'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping Enter Details Manually... two input boxes appeared labeled 'SM-DP+ Address' and 'Activation Code'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For the SM-DP+ Address, enter: cust-mobile.prod.s-net.co.uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typing cust-mobile.prod.s-net.co.uk into the SM-DP+ Address box. Got that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now I will read out the sixteen-character alphanumeric Activation Code: Lima, Oscar, 9, 2, Juliet, Echo, 4, 1, Tango, Romeo, 8, 8, Alpha, Charlie, 7, 7.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entering: L O 9 2 J E 4 1 T R 8 8 A C 7 7. Let me read that back: LO92-JE41-TR88-AC77.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is exactly correct. Now leave the Confirmation Code box blank, and tap Next in the top right corner.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping Next... the screen says 'Activating S-Net eSIM - this may take a few moments'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The phone is currently downloading the encrypted subscriber credentials over your home WiFi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The progress wheel is spinning... okay, it says 'Cellular Plan Added'! It is asking me to assign a label.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select Primary as the label, and set it as default line for voice, SMS, and mobile data.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selected Primary for everything... tapping Done. The top status bar has refreshed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have synchronized the network routing profile on our central telecommunications registry.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at the top right of the iPhone screen... S-Net 5G has appeared with four full signal bars!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the cryptographic eSIM profile has successfully bound to the device baseband processor, Una.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me turn off WiFi and test browsing a webpage over mobile data.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead, let us confirm 5G packet data throughput.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening the BBC News website on Safari... loaded instantly with full images! And I just received an incoming WhatsApp message.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check, Una, is your home broadband connection functioning normally as well without any issues?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our home broadband has been completely fine, it was solely the new iPhone eSIM setup.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now please perform a test outbound phone call to your landline or an automated time check to verify voice channels.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing 123 for the Speaking Clock... 'At the third stroke the time will be...'. Voice quality is crystal clear HD Voice!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That proves both VoLTE voice transmission and 5G mobile packet data are fully authenticated on your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What an enormous relief. Now the solicitors will be able to reach me for the two o'clock court hearing without any hitch.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your WiFi Calling toggle under Settings to ensure indoor coverage is optimal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping Wi-Fi Calling... turning the slider to ON. It says 'Wi-Fi Calling Active'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That ensures your phone will make high definition calls even in basement courtrooms with thick masonry.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is exceptionally valuable for my work in older court buildings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your voicemail setup to make sure unanswered calls can leave messages.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing my mobile voicemail... it says 'Welcome to your S-Net Voicemail, no new messages'. PIN is already remembered from my previous SIM.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your existing mailbox profile and saved greetings migrated automatically along with the phone number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That saves me having to record a new professional greeting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also review your international data roaming toggle under Mobile Data Options so you don't face unexpected roaming blocks when traveling for overseas court assignments.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good thinking. Under Mobile Data Options, Data Roaming is currently toggled OFF. Should I leave it OFF until I actually travel abroad?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, leaving Data Roaming OFF in the UK is best practice to prevent incidental boundary connections near coastal waters, and you can switch it ON whenever you arrive in the European Union.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will make sure to keep that toggled off until my next trip to The Hague.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check that your mobile hotspot or personal tethering is enabled in case you need internet on your laptop during court recesses.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking Personal Hotspot... yes, 'Allow Others to Join' is available and my laptop recognizes the iPhone hotspot right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your S-Net monthly plan includes sixty gigabytes of tethering data at full 5G speeds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is more than plenty for legal document review and email correspondence.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented the manual SM-DP+ eSIM profile provisioning on your customer account record, Una.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Liam for getting this sorted so quickly and professionally.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your new iPhone 15 or mobile tariff that I can assist with today, Una?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has solved my crisis completely. Thank you Liam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a successful court hearing this afternoon and have a good day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Liam, goodbye.
